description: Executable Candidate Ray TP2 recipe for Tencent Hy3 (295B MoE, 21B active) as the kodelow NVFP4 weight-only (W4A16, Marlin MoE) 181 GB checkpoint on two Sparks, following MiaAI-Lab's Hy3-Dual-DGX-Spark kit: its published vLLM image pinned by digest, MTP speculative decoding with one token, hy_v3 tool-call and reasoning parsers (the :opensource token patch is applied at build time), FP8 KV cache, eager mode, 128K context and six sequences. Code: no licence file upstream; model: Apache-2.0 (Tencent Hy3 and the quantization). The model card reports occasional Chinese output and tool-call failures that uncalibrated FP8 KV may amplify and recommends BF16 KV, which is offered as an option. Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.90 → 0.85. Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context and other kit flags are retained with a smaller KV pool. GB10 fit: GPU utilization 0.85 → 0.84 so the declared peak plus the 6 GB OS floor fits a Spark's idle available memory. Absolute KV correction: 21,217,935,360 bytes per rank covers 6 simultaneous full-context requests at 21,584 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context is capped from the creator profile's 131,072 tokens to 21,584 so selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead remain admissible on an idle Spark; full creator context with this concurrency does not fit. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: Hy3 295B NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks (Mia)
